correctness.rationale: A complete symbolic proof verifies integral Zinbiel and derivation identities, proves that the homogeneous D_i basis spans all derivations, and computes the bracket by values on the generator. For odd primes two adjoint tests leave at most the top element. For p=2, Lucas no-carry parity gives the exact first offending index 2^nu_2(i+1); binary digit counting proves the popcount formula for all n. The packaged checker independently verifies integer identities, direct finite commutators and 360 direct centre computations. The finite computations are not claimed as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact Lie centre basis of the derivation algebra, its unbounded binary popcount, and the all-field odd/even boundary were not found in the compared published-finding corpus records, available own-claim history or four inspected full primary sources. The most lexically similar article studies central-image derivations, a mathematically different object. Existing complex null-filiform classification is treated as prior, not as a discovery. The equivalent truncated positive divided-power Witt formulation was also searched without locating exact all-truncation centre coverage; priority risk from uninspected broader modular Witt theory is stated.

value.rationale: The centre of the full derivation Lie algebra is an intrinsic natural structural invariant of canonical one-generated null-filiform Zinbiel algebras. The result gives a complete homogeneous basis in every dimension, proves an unbounded logarithmic characteristic-two symmetry jump absent at odd primes, and identifies exact binary-carry mechanisms rather than a small ad hoc enumeration or isolated example.
